Golden minimal PAR2 set protecting payload.bin, eight bytes: ABCDEFGH.
The index contains Main, FileDesc and IFSC packets with MD5 packet/file/slice
hashes and the slice CRC32. The recovery volume repeats the index and adds
one eight-byte recovery slice, exponent 0. With one source slice its recovery
coefficient is 1, so the recovery bytes equal the source bytes.
Fixtures are binary protocol data, not generated by the implementation under test.
bad-recovery.par2 has valid packet MD5 but deliberately wrong recovery bytes;
the repaired file must fail comparison with the original file/slice checksums.

payload.vol0+2.par2 repeats the index and contains recovery exponents 0 and 1.
Exponent 1 uses PAR2 GF(65536) source constant 2 (primitive polynomial 0x1100b).
wrong-set.par2 changes every packet set ID and recalculates packet MD5; its
otherwise intact source description must not replace the pinned set.
